provenance.explanation: The developer uploaded the release file from the bakasayaka account. We haven't yet checked whether this file matches the public source code.

updates.label: Updates are set to come from fanyj/douban-to-zotero on GitHub, which doesn't exist or isn't public: if the owner of "fanyj" published an update there, Zotero would install it
updates.check: The update address is broken (nothing is there), so Zotero can't update it

sourceTransparency.label: Updates are set to come from an address someone else could control

dataSharing.label: Only contacts services we could identify

badges.label: Works with files on your computer

compatibility.label: Doesn't work with Zotero 10; works with Zotero 9
